digest.component_or_area: stability program track I - defect introduction reduction
propositions: Gate-runtime, product-logic representation drift, and test isolation under worktree parallelism account for ~55% of defects in a 120-bug mechanism sample
Enforcement mechanisms must be deterministic, harness-neutral, and deterministically fail make lint on policy violation without relying on prose or harness hooks
MCP tool surface must be deterministically cross-checked against library facade; live mirrors must be gated/generated or have linked discovery tickets
Subprocess-spawning tests must obtain isolation roots from the harness; collection-time validation must enforce this rule
Mechanism additions must be recorded against a committed shrink-only baseline and justified; unjustified additions fail make lint
Upstream measurement reads for rework vs change size, CI landing regressions, and environment failures must be published with per-case tables and size-rule enforcement decision recorded
